properties.displayName: ImageMagick: Policy Bypass in DCM decoder could result in image with invalid dimensions
properties.description: ImageMagick: Policy Bypass in DCM decoder could result in image with invalid dimensions
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "imagemagick" or Msg contains "policy" or message_s contains "imagemagick" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), SourceIP | where count_ > 3 // GHADV-1757
